title: Would, And Six Lines About A Trip
label: ch:ar-would-and-six-lines
canDo: I can say what I would do if things were different, say that a plan depends on something, and write six connected lines about a trip.

payoff.summary: Complete AR-R292-would-and-depends: an unreal condition with law, a wish with layta, and a plan that depends on something, with ʿalā ḥasab and the condition word.
